shots.narration: 消息队列，可以先接住待处理的任务。网站把同一笔订单的处理任务，写进队列。
先等队列确认任务已经可靠保存，再告诉页面已提交。这个确认，不代表后面的业务已经做完。
后台有空时，再接收一笔任务来处理。看，七零四二开始处理，其他任务仍然等待。
后台按自己的处理能力，完成这笔订单的工作。任务已经送出，也不能立刻当成处理成功。
处理确认，要等业务真正成功后再发送。队列收到确认，才把这次投递视为完成。
再看下一笔：后台处理到一半，连接断了。因为还没收到处理确认，队列不能把它算成成功。
在这里采用的手动确认模式下，连接断开会触发重新投递。还是同一笔任务，不是用户又下了一单。
也可能业务已经成功，只是确认没送到。任务再来一次时，程序要避免把同一笔业务重复执行。
削峰，就是把短时间的集中任务，摊开来处理。队列没有让后台瞬间变快，只是允许任务先等一会儿。

supports: Consumer acknowledgements and publisher confirms are orthogonal/unaware of each other.
Manual acknowledgement mode requeues an unacknowledged delivery when its channel/connection closes; detection takes time.
Successful processing acknowledgements allow the message to be discarded; application must handle redeliveries idempotently.

authorityReading.actuallyRead: Relevant official body sections read in this audit, not a search snippet or old project draft
supports: Topics durably retain events; events are not deleted merely because consumed.
Per-topic configuration determines retention/discard; repeated reads are possible.

authorityReading.actuallyRead: Relevant official body sections read in this audit, not a search snippet or old project draft
supports: Consumer Position: ordinary consumer groups track offsets, not RabbitMQ per-delivery removal semantics.
Message Delivery Semantics: publishing durability and consumption processing guarantees are separate.
Writing to external systems requires cooperation/coordination with that system; Kafka transactions do not automatically make independentSQL writes globally atomic.

authorityReading.actuallyRead: Relevant official body sections read in this audit, not a search snippet or old project draft
supports: Official producerJavadoc: application-level re-sends cannot be deduplicated by producer idempotence.
Idempotence guarantee is limited to messages sent in a single producer session; business eventE8124 is not a globally unique Kafka deduplication instruction.

authorityReading.actuallyRead: Relevant official body sections read in this audit, not a search snippet or old project draft
supports: Persist half transaction message before producer local transaction, then commit/rollback message visibility based on local result.
Unknown/lost second confirmation causes a check of producer local transaction state, not downstream inventory consumption.
Transaction messages do not guarantee downstream consumer result is consistent with upstream local transaction; asynchronous scope and timeout boundaries remain.
